title: Azure growth accelerates above 50%
html:
Proposition

Azure growth accelerates above 50%

Microsoft reports constant-currency Azure growth above 50.0% for the December quarter at its January 27, 2027 report.

When
The decision on Jan 27, 2027
Known from
Microsoft fiscal Q2 2027 earnings release
Forecast28.0%
0%100%

How it’s set

Rationale

Another beat of the size of last quarter's against a 49%-50% expectation puts growth above 50%. Microsoft has beaten its Azure guidance in recent quarters, but capacity is the limit management cites, so I put this a little above one in four.
